observations: Photos show a sewing/weaving machine frame/stand with a rectangular top and a cut-out opening (likely where the machine head sits).
The stand has black metal legs and a lower foot/gear area with a grated platform.
The top surface appears to be wood (or wood-like) with visible grain and wear.
No motor, handwheel, belt, or machine head is clearly visible in the photos—only the base/legs/stand.
A measuring tape is visible in photo 2 across the top edge (suggesting dimensions were taken).
A watermark/overlay text is present on the images, but no clear brand/model label is readable.

claims.evidence: The photos show a sewing/weaving machine base/stand with legs and a top opening (photo 0-3).
The seller text includes a number, but the photos do not show any price tag or receipt.
Location is only in the seller text; photos do not confirm Ibadan.

risks.risk: This may be only the stand/legs (no machine head). If you need the complete sewing/weaving machine, the value is much lower.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the full machine (including the machine head/gearbox/motor or handwheel) and confirm what exactly is included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: Price as stand/legs only (no working machine head).

risks.risk: Fit/compatibility risk: the top opening size and mounting points may not match your machine head.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the mounting holes/brackets and the opening dimensions (with a ruler) plus a photo of the underside mounting plate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially requiring adjustment/adapter (assume buyer may need extra parts).

risks.risk: Condition risk: wood top could be cracked/warped; metal could be bent or rusted; welds could be weak.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of cracks, weld joints, and any rust spots, plus a photo from the side showing straightness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (assume not perfectly straight and may need minor repairs).

risks.risk: Missing parts risk: the lower mechanism/platform or any linkage parts might be incomplete.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the entire base from all sides and a checklist of included parts (platform, levers, any belt guards/rollers).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown parts (assume buyer may need to source missing components).

proof_requests: Confirm what is included: legs/stand only, or complete sewing/weaving machine (machine head + motor/handwheel).
Send close-up photos of the mounting area: top opening edges, mounting holes/brackets, and underside mounting plate.
Send close-up photos of welds/joints and the wood top (any cracks/warping).
Send photos of the lower platform/any levers/rollers to confirm nothing is missing.
response.reason: From the photos, this appears to be a sewing/weaving machine stand/legs only, but the seller’s exact inclusion and compatibility (and whether any machine head/working parts are included) can’t be confirmed remotely. Proof is needed to price correctly and avoid buying the wrong parts.
